# NodeFlow Architecture Studio — LLM Knowledge Base

> Open source (MIT), browser-native, local-first visual diagramming, system architecture, and threat modeling studio.
> Official Website: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/muhamadzolfaghari/node-flow

## Executive Summary
NodeFlow is an AI-native browser workspace combining high-speed code editing, a bidirectional live canvas, an autonomous architecture evaluation agent, and universal format converters. It operates entirely client-side with 0 external telemetry, storing drafts and checkpoints in local IndexedDB storage.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Specifications
- **AI-Native Architecture Agent**: Deterministically classifies system topologies (Layered N-Tier, Microservices, Event-Driven Streaming, Cloud VPC, Relational Schemas), calculates Fan-in / Fan-out coupling metrics, detects Single Points of Failure (SPOF) and anti-patterns (such as direct client-to-database bypasses), and generates formal Markdown architecture decision records (ADR).
- **STRIDE Threat Modeling & Compliance**: Evaluates trust boundaries, unencrypted inter-service channels, and exposed databases; generates formal SOC2 / ISO 27001 audit reports.
- **Request Flow Simulation**: Animates interactive request packets and photon pulses along directed edges for real-time visual system debugging.
- **High-Performance Editor & Diagnostics**: 160ms debounced linter with column squiggles, in-editor AI Quick Fix actions, line jump navigation, and smart connection arrow autocompletion.
- **Universal 38-Format Conversion Registry**: Bi-directional conversion and editable previews for Draw.io XML, PlantUML, Graphviz DOT (native Wasm C compiler), D2, SQL DDL, DBML, Prisma, Protobuf, JSON Schema, GraphQL SDL, BPMN 2.0, C4 DSL, Terraform HCL, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, Lucidchart, OmniGraffle, Miro, StarUML, Visio VDX, Gliffy, Excalidraw, XMind ZEN, GeoJSON, ESRI Shapefile, and Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) protobuf specifications.
- **51 Production Starter Templates**: Curated across 8 cross-disciplinary categories:
  - *Product Managers (PM)*: User story mapping (backbone vs. MVP/V2 slices), quarterly OKRs, and customer journey maps.
  - *QA & Testing*: Defect triage state lifecycles, automated CI/CD quality gate pipelines, and regression verification matrices.
  - *Software Engineers & Architects*: Microservices VPC, C4 system context/containers, relational ER schemas, and Git trunk release flows.
  - *Operations & Governance*: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) multi-level compliance chains and corporate org charts.
  - *Students & Academics*: Thesis literature reviews, scientific method lab protocols, and semester course study plans.
  - *14 UML Specifications*: Full OMG UML 2.5 coverage including class, sequence, state, activity, component, deployment, use case, and package diagrams.
